why each call was made (full table in editor-wireframe.html §39)
Rail = 4 locked slots (Insert·Media·Pages·Design) — spine fixed → muscle memory [#15·#14]
Publish = the only dark box — one screen, one purpose [#5·#4]
AI = topbar ✨, not a rail slot — helper across jobs, don’t crown it [#5·#8]
AI never auto-mutates → propose → confirm → execute (single-use token) [#5·#3·#13]
Layers → footer ⌗ popover — frequent but micro [#14·#9]
Shared DS push = a Brand action (the agency wedge) + blast-radius confirm [#14·#5]
Brand merges tokens+styles+components — one job, one home [#14]
Every panel has empty/loading/error — happy path is ~10% [#13·#2]
Open ties — test, don’t debate: Media own-slot vs Insert sub-tab · Layers footer vs Pages · Components sub-tab vs slot · Presence slot (gated, ship dark).
